Peeling blue-grey wall paint and water rings on desk. Foreground curtain edge, middle desk with kraft document envelope and loose cream papers, background narrow bed with rumpled grey bedding and slippers. Overcast cold window light, one warm lamp. No people.

Cracked tiles and chipped enamel. Cold afternoon with small warm bulb. No people.

Cold grey daylight. No people, no birds, no lettering or plates.

Worn dark blue compact car stopped near right shoulder, windshield repair tape and thermos visible through glass. Foreground dusty rail bolt and cracked asphalt. Cold overcast daylight. No people, no signs or road text.

scenes.gas: Inside modest rural Chinese petrol station shop, worn laminate counter running diagonally at right, scratched countertop with blank receipt paper, yellowed plastic stool and plain thermos, peeling wall corner, window framing empty mountain road, foreground door frame at left. No commercial signs, packaging lettering or numbers. Cold daylight and one warm bulb. No people.
scenes.gate: Memory of ordinary Chinese small town school entrance, intact faded green gate, chipped plaster boundary wall and rusted hinges, foreground bicycle handlebar, middle small plastic stool beside gate, background low classrooms and laundry on side balcony. Muted warmer grey afternoon but same cel style, no signs, numbers or lettering. No people.
scenes.old-room: Memory of modest small town sitting room, weathered wooden chair at left, square table with blank exercise book and capped pen, chipped enamel thermos and bowl, foreground door frame, background scuffed wall with peeling pale green paint and courtyard doorway. Cold daylight with warm small bulb. No people, no written words.
